Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) accepted a supplemental New Drug Application (“NDA”) submission for Yeztugo 300-mg tablet as a potential once-weekly oral formulation for HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis, with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (“PDUFA”) target action date of February 2, 2027.
• Announced FDA accepted an NDA for bictegravir and lenacapavir for virologically suppressed people with HIV under priority review, with a PDUFA target action date of August 27, 2026.

The decision was based on the recommendation of the external Data Monitoring Committee, following review of data from a pre-specified final analysis of progression-free survival and interim analysis of overall survival.
• Announced that the Biologics License Application for anito-cel in 4L+ R/R MM has been accepted by FDA, with a PDUFA target action date of December 23, 2026.
